hypothesis: The capacity result is a property of the estimator, not of the frozen corner of parameter space. Across correlations and chain lengths: the C = 1 kernel should sit on the LMMSE floor everywhere (Proposition 1, so this is also a check on the apparatus), and C = 8 should sit below it everywhere, with the margin varying smoothly.
design: rho in (0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.85, 0.95) x L in (16, 32, 64), Laplace innovation, M = 512, 8 seeds; C in (1, 8) plus the LMMSE and isotropic oracles on the same held-out bundles; protocol ladder and validation selection; the crossover t_*(rho, L) is recorded per cell.
predeclared_analysis: per (rho, L): the ratio of the C = 1 error to the LMMSE floor, which Proposition 1 puts at 1 everywhere; the paired C1 - C8 difference with a seed bootstrap; and whether the margin tracks t_* or the fixed schedule.
